definitions.gloss: fatty meat; the fat portion of meat
definitions.explanation: The white, fatty part of meat as opposed to the lean red portion. Refers to the visible fat on cuts of beef, pork, or other meats.

examples.japanese: {脂身|あぶらみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧だ。
examples.english: This is meat with a lot of fat.

examples.japanese: {脂身|あぶらみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like lean meat with little fat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脂身|あぶらみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦とろける→とろける：28626_torokeru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
examples.english: The fat on wagyu beef is so soft it melts in your mouth.

notes:
An essential food vocabulary word. In Japanese cuisine, the quality and marbling of fat (⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧) is highly valued, especially in beef. The balance between {脂身|あぶらみ} and ⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧ (lean meat) is a key topic when discussing meat quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脂身|あぶらみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: fatty, high in fat
- {脂身|あぶらみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: lean, low in fat
- {脂身|あぶらみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to trim the fat
- {脂身|あぶらみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧: fat and lean portions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧: lean meat — the opposite, the red, lean portion
- ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧: fat (as a substance) — more scientific/nutritional term
- ⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧: marbling — the fine distribution of fat within lean meat, highly prized in wagyu
